title: Bakery website
blurb: Fixed-price website with five add-on requests, a withdrawn agreement and a changed mind.
contract: Project: 5-page website for a bakery (Home, Menu, About, Gallery, Contact). Fixed price: $800, 50% upfront. Delivery in 3 weeks. Includes two rounds of design revisions. Excluded: online ordering, payment integration, blog, hosting management.
thread:
Rafi: Hi Nila! First draft of the homepage is up, link is in your email 🙂
Nila: omg it looks so good!! 😍
Nila: can we make the banner colour a bit warmer? like the caramel colour from our logo
Rafi: Sure, that's a design revision, will do it today
Rafi: Updated, have a look
Nila: perfect 👍
Nila: also my cousin said customers should be able to order cakes on the site directly, can you add online ordering?
Rafi: Online ordering isn't part of the current package (it's in the excluded list), it would be separate work. I can send you a quote if you want
Nila: Hmm, let me think about it.
Nila: oh and on the Menu page, can u show the prices in a table
Rafi: Yep no problem
Nila: actually wait, forget the table, just a simple list under each cake photo is better
Rafi: Got it, simple list 👍
Nila: will you also set up a blog? i want to post my recipes every week
Rafi: A blog is outside the package too. Happy to quote it if you're interested
Nila: ok maybe later
Nila: Can you add a Bengali version of the site? Many of my customers read Bengali
Rafi: That's extra work. It would be $150 for the translation setup + the Bengali pages (you send me the text). Want me to go ahead?
Nila: yes sounds good, go ahead!
Rafi: Great, I'll start on it tomorrow
Nila: hey sorry, actually forget the Bengali version. my sister says english is enough for now
Rafi: No problem, I'll skip it.
Nila: also can we have google analytics so i can see how many ppl visit?
Rafi: Yes that's doable, it's not in the package though. I will send you a price tomorrow
Nila: ok please send it when you can
Rafi: Will do!
Nila: one more thing, can u add a small whatsapp button so people can reserve a cake? just a link to my number
Rafi: Sure, that's tiny, no extra cost 🙂
Nila: thank youuu
Nila: i saw other bakeries show their instagram photos on the website. can u add an instagram feed to the gallery page?
Rafi: I can! It's outside the package: $120 for the feed widget setup. Want me to do it?
Nila: yes please go ahead
Rafi: Done, it's live on the Gallery page
Nila: looks great, thanks!
Nila: when will the whole site be ready?
Rafi: Should be ready by Friday for final review.
